ab.p1: I'm Vahid Faraji, and I work in applied AI. I build workflows, data pipelines and agents that teams use in their daily work. I write the spec, build the tools the agent can use, and measure whether it actually helps.
ab.p2: Eight years in industry and four in research. This site is the companion to Applied AI, Simplified, the book I'm writing.
ab.title: Who makes this site

sm.h2: Which skill opens the most doors
sm.l1: Tap a skill to see what it is asked with.
sm.l2: Tick what you can do. See which next skill opens the most postings.
sm.l3: Power pairs come together; unicorn combos are rare in one person.
sm.m1: Each bead is a skill, sized by how many postings ask for it. A line joins two skills when postings ask for them together more often than chance; the thicker the line, the stronger the pull.
sm.m2: You meet a posting when you have every skill it asks for. Each missing skill is ranked by how many more postings it would open, and the path shows the fewest skills to reach half the market.
sm.m3: Lift is how many times more often two skills are asked for together than if they were unrelated. Above 1, they come as a pair: learn them together. Below 1, a posting that asks for both is hunting a rare profile: if you have both, lead with them.
